Construction Services in Towanda, KS

Towanda is a small Butler County community of roughly 1,500 residents northeast of Wichita along US-400, near the Whitewater River in the eastern edge of Sedgwick County influence. The area is semi-rural — a small townsite surrounded by agricultural land and acreage properties. It sits in Butler County school district territory and draws homeowners who want rural space within reasonable distance of El Dorado and Wichita.

Wheatland Construction is based in El Dorado — Towanda is part of our core Butler County service territory. We permit through Butler County for rural properties and through the City of Towanda for in-town work.

What We Build in Towanda

Custom Homes

Towanda-area rural acreage lots attract homeowners building custom homes with space between neighbors. We build custom homes in the Towanda area from foundation through finish — Butler County permits, all construction with our own crews. See Custom Home Building in Towanda →

Home Additions

Older Towanda-area properties — farmhouses and rural homes — frequently need square footage they weren't built with. Room additions and functional expansions are common requests. We match existing exterior materials and rooflines throughout. See Home Additions in Towanda →

Basement Finishing

Towanda-area rural properties include homes with older basements that have never been finished. The Butler County soil profile — clay-loam with seasonal moisture pressure — requires careful assessment before any framing begins. We evaluate moisture conditions at every Towanda-area basement before recommending a scope. See Basement Finishing in Towanda →

Bathroom Remodeling

Towanda's older housing stock has original mid-century bathrooms — galvanized plumbing, original tile, dated fixtures — that have been in service long past their useful life. We remodel them completely, including plumbing updates where the original systems need replacement. See Bathroom Remodeling in Towanda →

Kitchen Remodeling

Rural Towanda-area kitchens range from original farmhouse layouts with limited counter space to newer kitchens that just need updating. We handle the full range — from targeted refreshes to full gut-and-replace — with Butler County permits and our own crews. See Kitchen Remodeling in Towanda →

Major Remodels

Older Butler County farmhouses in the Towanda area sometimes need comprehensive renovation — projects where structural, mechanical, and finish work all need to happen together. We handle major remodel scopes with full Butler County permit management. See Major Remodels in Towanda →

Roofing

Butler County sees significant spring hail and wind. Rural Towanda-area properties are often more wind-exposed than in-town homes — and hail damage can be severe on older roofing systems. We install roofing appropriate for Butler County conditions and handle insurance documentation. See Roofing in Towanda →

Towanda Permit Jurisdiction

Most Towanda-area work permits through Butler County. In-town properties permit through the City of Towanda. We handle all permits and inspections.
